description: Subscribe to movement alerts for a DCPI market (FREE with a key) — get notified when its Excess-Power / Constraint score moves. On the free tier, email alerts are delivered to the email your human bound via bind_email (call bind_email first; the destination is forced to that address). Set channel="email". Webhook delivery (channel="webhook" + destination=<https URL>) needs a paid DC Hub plan. Lets an agent MONITOR markets, not just query them. Answers "tell me when this market moves", "ping me if Northern Virginia’s power score changes". Try: set_market_alert market=northern-virginia channel=webhook destination=https://hooks.example.com/dc. Do NOT use to read a market right now (use get_market_dcpi_rank); this SUBSCRIBES to future movement.

channel.description: Delivery channel: "email" (free, sent to your bound email) or "webhook" (paid plan)

destination.description: For channel="webhook", the https URL to POST alerts to (paid plan); ignored for email (forced to bound address)

market.description: Market slug (metro) to watch, e.g. northern-virginia — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

name: set_market_alert
title: Set Market Alert
